prompt: A research team wants to understand why some postgraduate students discontinue a mentoring programme despite attending the first sessions. Explain when and how a qualitative design could answer this question, including sampling and limits on generalization.
expected_key_points: focus on experience, meaning, and process
justify purposive or theoretically informed sampling
prohibited_errors: treat qualitative work as inferior by definition
limitations: Specification only until tested against a real candidate model.
